parameters.query:
select
  t.id, t.date, t.description, t.category_id, t.value, t.type,
  t.installment_number, t.total_installments, t.reconciled,
  t.account_id,
  coalesce(a.name, case when t.account_id = 'dinheiro' then 'Dinheiro' else null end) as conta_nome,
  a.bank
from public.transactions t
left join public.accounts a on a.id::text = t.account_id
where t.owner_id = $1::uuid
  and t.deleted = false
  and (nullif($2, '') is null or t.description ilike '%' || $2 || '%')
  and (nullif($3, '') is null
       or abs(t.value) between abs(nullif($3,'')::numeric) * 0.85
                           and abs(nullif($3,'')::numeric) * 1.15)
  and (nullif($4, '') is null or t.date >= nullif($4,'')::date)
  and (nullif($5, '') is null or t.date <= nullif($5,'')::date)
  and (nullif($6, '') is null or t.category_id = $6)
order by t.date desc
limit 15;

with conta_resolvida as (
  select a.id::text as account_id
  from public.accounts a
  where (a.owner_id = $2::uuid or a.user_id = $3::uuid)
    and nullif($9, '') is not null
    and (
      $9 ilike '%' || a.bank || '%'
      or $9 ilike '%' || a.name || '%'
      or (a.type = 'credito' and $9 ilike '%cart%')
      or (a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        $9 ilike '%deb%' or $9 ilike '%déb%' or $9 ilike '%pix%' or $9 ilike '%conta%'
      ))
    )
  order by
    case when ($9 ilike '%' || a.bank || '%' or $9 ilike '%' || a.name || '%') then 0 else 1 end,
    case
      when a.type = 'credito' and $9 ilike '%cart%' then 0
      when a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        $9 ilike '%deb%' or $9 ilike '%déb%' or $9 ilike '%pix%' or $9 ilike '%conta%'
      ) then 0
      else 1
    end
  limit 1
),
atualizado as (
  update public.transactions t
  set description = coalesce(nullif($4, ''), t.description),
      value       = coalesce(nullif($5, '')::numeric, t.value),
      date        = coalesce(nullif($6, '')::date, t.date),
      category_id = coalesce(nullif($7, ''), t.category_id),
      type        = coalesce(nullif($8, ''), t.type),
      account_id  = case
                      when nullif($9, '') is null then t.account_id
                      else coalesce((select account_id from conta_resolvida), 'dinheiro')
                    end
  where t.id = $1::uuid
    and t.owner_id = $2::uuid
    and t.deleted = false
  returning t.id, t.date, t.description, t.category_id, t.value, t.type, t.account_id, t.owner_id
),
periodo as (
  select
    date_trunc('month', (select date from atualizado))::date as mes_inicio,
    (date_trunc('month', (select date from atualizado)) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date as mes_fim
),
meses as (
  select extract(year from mes_ref)::int as ano, extract(month from mes_ref)::int - 1 as mes_idx
  from (select generate_series((select mes_inicio from periodo), (select mes_fim from periodo), interval '1 month')::date as mes_ref) g
),
planejado as (
  select coalesce(sum(b.planned_value), 0) as planejado
  from public.budgets b
  join meses m on b.year = m.ano and b.month = m.mes_idx
  where b.owner_id = (select owner_id from atualizado)
    and b.category_id = (select category_id from atualizado)
),
realizado as (
  -- Postgres: um CTE nao enxerga as alteracoes feitas por outro CTE no mesmo statement
  -- (todos usam o mesmo snapshot). Por isso somamos os OUTROS lancamentos e adicionamos
  -- o valor novo separadamente — assim o total ja reflete a edicao recem-feita.
  select coalesce(sum(abs(t.value)), 0) + abs((select value from atualizado)) as realizado
  from public.transactions t, periodo p
  where t.owner_id = (select owner_id from atualizado)
    and t.category_id = (select category_id from atualizado)
    and t.type = (select type from atualizado)
    and t.deleted = false
    and t.id <> (select id from atualizado)
    and t.date >= p.mes_inicio and t.date <= p.mes_fim
),
conta_final as (
  select a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where a.id::text = (select account_id from atualizado)
)
select
  (select id from atualizado) as lancamento_id,
  (select description from atualizado) as description,
  (select date from atualizado) as date,
  (select category_id from atualizado) as category_id,
  (select value from atualizado) as value,
  (select type from atualizado) as type,
  (select account_id from atualizado) as account_id,
  (select bank from conta_final) as bank,
  coalesce(
    (select account_name from conta_final),
    case when (select account_id from atualizado) = 'dinheiro' then 'Dinheiro' else null end
  ) as account_name,
  (select planejado from planejado) as planejado,
  (select realizado from realizado) as realizado,
  (select mes_inicio from periodo) as mes_inicio,
  (select mes_fim from periodo) as mes_fim;
